en: Black‑and‑white view of a tall cylindrical stone tower with a conical roof rising from a fortified base on a riverbank. The massive medieval-looking structure is attached to other stone buildings with small windows. In the foreground is calm water reflecting the tower and an adjacent bridge with railings. On the opposite bank stand several gabled houses covered in vines, and behind them a tall factory chimney, suggesting an early industrial townscape next to an old fortification.
